heading: Liability for acts of officers and agents
lead: The corporation is liable for the acts of its officers and agents acting within the scope of their authority.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2210936:346 (1st sentence).Sept. 20, 1950, ch. 958, § 6 (1st sentence), 64 Stat. 871. The words “acting within the scope of their authority” are added for clarity and consistency in the revised title.
